'''Rigo''' was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who lived at the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the conflict between the Republic and the Separatists, he and a gang of bounty hunters attacked [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and the [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Alpha (Advanced Recon Commando)|Alpha-17]], which had previously landed on Riflor. Rigo and his gang lured the two into a dead end and convert them. Shortly after [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] arrived to [[Rescue at Riflor|rescue]] Obi-Wan, in which they managed to overwhelm the gang and Rigo was killed in the fight.
